answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 4915 Country: Bangladesh Title: I would like to know about Dream-Interpretation (Tabeer). I'm heard that Dreams are of 3 types, one from Allah, one from Shaitan and another with no explanation. Suppose, I saw a dream and asked three different Scholars/Mufti for the Interpretation/Tabeer of my dream and all of them interpreted my dreams with different meanings, so what interpretation should I consider? the interpretation given by the first Scholar or the interpretation which seems to be more positive/best to me? Question: Assalamu-alaikum, I would like to know about Dream-Interpretation (Tabeer). I'm heard that Dreams are of 3 types, one from Allah, one from Shaitan and another with no explanation. Suppose, I saw a dream and asked three different Scholars/Mufti for the Interpretation/Tabeer of my dream and all of them interpreted my dreams with different meanings, so what interpretation should I consider? the interpretation given by the first Scholar or the interpretation which seems to be more positive/best to me? Zazakallahu Khairan. Answer ID: 4915 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1022/890=B/1429) You should expect from Allah from the interpretation most suitable to you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
